Pioneering
Accreditation Standards

At the Gulf Academic Accreditation and Authentication Agency (GAAAC), we are committed to setting the benchmark for excellence in academic accreditation across the Gulf region. Our rigorous standards ensure that educational institutions meet global best practices, empowering students and fostering academic integrity. Whether within the Gulf or beyond, our mission is to raise the standard of education across borders.

Who We Are

Your Partner in
Academic Accreditation

GAAAC is dedicated to enhancing the quality and credibility of educational institutions across the Gulf region and beyond. With a focus on academic excellence, we provide accreditation and authentication services that ensure institutions meet international standards. Our agency works closely with colleges, universities, and other educational entities to foster continuous improvement and to help them achieve global recognition.

In a rapidly evolving business landscape, success demands agility and innovation. With us as your partner, you’ll navigate change with confidence—whether reinventing your business model, adapting to shifting tax regulations, or overcoming resource challenges. Our human-centric, tech-driven approach propels your business toward accelerated growth and lasting success.

Countries We Work At

Elevating Global Academic
Standards Worldwide

Gulf Countries

At GAAAC, our primary focus is on the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries, where we help educational institutions uphold high standards of academic excellence. We collaborate with universities, colleges, and other academic bodies to ensure their programs meet both regional and international accreditation criteria.

  • Saudi Arabia
  • United Arab Emirates
  • Kuwait
  • Qatar
  • Oman
  • Bahrain

Non-Gulf Countries

While our core operations are centered in the Gulf, GAAAC extends its expertise to non-Gulf countries as well. We partner with institutions in these regions, offering tailored accreditation services that help them meet international education standards. Our goal is to support these institutions in achieving global recognition and maintaining high academic credibility.

  • United States
  • Canada
  • Egypt
  • Morocco
  • And many more

Global Presence

One Location,
Worldwide Presence

Our services are never bound by borders. At GAAAC, we truly believe that education knows no boundaries, and every deserving institution deserves to be recognized on a larger scale. We are committed to ensuring that academic excellence extends beyond regional limitations, helping institutions across different regions gain the recognition they deserve. Whether it's a university in the Gulf or a college in a distant country, we bring the same level of dedication and expertise to help them achieve international accreditation and enhance their global standing. Through our efforts, we aim to foster a world where quality education is accessible, recognized, and celebrated, no matter where an institution is located.
